article.title: Income from profits and gains of business or profession, how computed.
article.content:
29Income from profits and gains of business or profession, how computed.

Section 29  ·  Chapter IV  ·  D.—Profits and gains of business or profession  ·  page 98 of the Act
The income referred to in section 28 shall be computed in accordance with the provisions contained in sections 30 to 43D.
